Essential proteins are abundant, and abundant proteins are the ones mass spectrometry finds most, so methylated proteins are expected to be enriched among commonly essential genes whatever methylation does; cancer_change = methylarginines with a missense or stop change in at least one TCGA tumour (MC3 calls, category tcga_tumours) or DepMap 24Q4 cell line (depmap_cell_lines), against the other arginines of the methylated proteins whose gene DepMap screened: pooled (method fisher) and within each protein (method mantel_haenszel, each protein a stratum). A pathway holds the proteins of all its sub-pathways (UniProt2Reactome_All_Levels), and pathways of 10 to 500 such proteins are tested.
